verdict.rationale: PostHog is a product-analytics platform, so cookieless tracking is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions cookieless tracking, cookie-free persistence modes, or reducing consent-banner requirements. Self-hosting and general event capture are adjacent features and do not show that usage can be tracked without cookies.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track product usage without third-party cookies so I can minimize or avoid cookie consent banners
